result.instructions: Tools for Sapling HR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which people in the Sales department started in the last 90 days?"; "Show me the job title and manager of the employee with this GUID."; "List the tasks that are still open for jane@acme.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sapling HR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sapling_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sapling_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sapling_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sapling_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sapling_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List employees (profiles) in the Sapling account, with job, location, department, manager and employment status. Filter by status, department, location, manager GUID, employment status, or start-date range. Each result has a guid for sapling_get_user. Sapling API: GET /profiles.

employment_status.description: Employment status, for example Full Time.

start_date_since.description: Start date on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

start_date_until.description: Start date on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use with total_pages in the response.

tools.name: sapling_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one employee's full profile by GUID, including job details tables and custom tables. Sapling API: GET /profiles/{GUID}.

tools.name: sapling_list_fields
tools.title: List profile fields
tools.description: List the profile fields that the API can read in this Sapling account, with id, name, section and field type. Use it to learn the field names before you read a profile. Sapling API: GET /profiles/fields.

tools.name: sapling_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List onboarding and HR tasks in the Sapling account. Give owner_email to list the tasks of one person. Sapling API: GET /tasks.

owner_email.description: Only tasks owned by this email address.
